descriptions.description: The geocontract federated catalog, expressed in the GSA DCAT-US 3.0.0 vocabulary. This contract governs the catalog envelope that bundles every published *.geocontract.yaml instance record — currently the NEPA Categorical Exclusions catalogue and the PIC NEPA Data Standard v1.2, with room for additional agency-published contracts to be registered over time. Consumers (mesh gateways, search indexes, dashboards, the federated harvester) resolve this catalog to discover the available datasets, their distributions (ODCS YAML + source payloads), and the data services that expose them. Each `dataset[]` entry is a DCAT-US `dcat:Dataset` whose `conformsTo` points at ODCS v3.1.0 and whose `distribution[]` enumerates the contract YAML and the source payload. DCAT-US 3.0.0 is the published federal vocabulary; the GSA repo also ships draft v3.x sub-definitions that may change. We pin the snapshot used for validation under external/dcat-us-definitions/. The catalog itself is currently an example document; production deployment will publish the catalog at https://geocontract.dev/ and the federated harvester will refresh it on a schedule.
